subject: mathematics
question_text: Show that in △ABC, a = b cos C + c cos B.

mark_split.label: Write both cosines by the cosine rule

verification.note: Source: Sri Chaitanya, FAST TRACK IPE for Jr. Students — Mathematics-IA (2026-27 edition), book p.123, chapter 12 PROPERTIES OF TRIANGLES, Very Short Answer question 9. recall_prompt: Say how you would prove this — name each standard result you use and the order you use them in.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Write both cosines by the cosine rule
steps.margin_note: Half the marks. cos C sits over 2ab and cos B over 2ca — the two sides that meet at that angle.
steps.memory_tip: The denominator of a cosine is twice the product of the two sides that meet at that angle: cos C over 2ab, cos B over 2ca.
lines: R.H.S = b cos C + c cos B

recall.must_convey: That cos C = (a²+b²−c²)/(2ab) and cos B = (c²+a²−b²)/(2ca) are substituted into b cos C + c cos B.
accept: write both cosines by the cosine rule and put them into the right hand side
cos C is a squared plus b squared minus c squared over two a b
the denominator is twice the product of the two sides meeting at the angle
cosine rule vaadi rendu cosines rasi substitute cheyyali
start from the right hand side and expand the cosines

steps.why: The left side is a plain side and the right side carries two cosines, so the cosines must go first. The cosine rule is the only result that writes a cosine using the three sides.
common_mistakes: Using cos C = (a² + b² − c²)/(2bc) with the wrong pair of sides.
Starting from the left side, which has nothing to expand.

steps.label: Cancel and add
steps.margin_note: The other mark. Both fractions reduce to a denominator of 2a, and then b² and c² cancel in pairs.
steps.memory_tip: After cancelling, both fractions sit over 2a; b² and c² then cancel in pairs and leave 2a².

lines.text: ∴ b cos C + c cos B = a = L.H.S

recall.must_convey: That both terms reduce to a denominator of 2a, b² and c² cancel, and 2a²/(2a) = a.
accept: the b cancels and the c cancels so both are over two a
b squared and c squared cancel leaving two a squared
two a squared over two a is a
b and c cancel ayipoyi rendu two a meeda vasthayi
add the two fractions and everything but two a squared cancels

steps.why: The b outside cancels the b in 2ab and the c cancels the c in 2ca, so both fractions land on the same denominator 2a. Then b² and c² cancel in pairs and only 2a² is left.
common_mistakes: Cancelling the a instead of the b, leaving different denominators.
Losing a sign so that b² and c² do not cancel.
